titles.title: teamGate allows with no tracker call when there is no policy, teamMode is false or claimsEnforced is false
teamGate allows an unassigned stage for author and build and adds the actor through addAssignee (implicitClaim true), and takes no claim for approve-local or applying a finding
teamGate recognises a developer assigned directly in the tracker as the holder with no separate claim, comparing logins case-insensitively
teamGate returns held-by-other naming the holder for author, build, approve-local, apply and open-signoff, whatever the holder's idle time
the first author turn of a stage with no issue and no artifact is allowed as an explicit exception and any other action on a stage with no issue is refused

the registered completion hook is consulted for author and build on a next stage and for open-signoff, revise and release, a release called by the hook does not consult it again, and with none registered the gate behaves as continue (a hook-contract test; the completion-releases-the-claim integration test belongs to s7)
each port failure kind, several assignees, an unreadable policy, a missing issue and a throwing completion hook map to refused or no-issue with the reason and never throw
claim takes only an unassigned stage, never removes another assignee, and reports a contested claim or a failed re-read as refused
release clears the assignees for the holder and for an administrator, including a contested claim, and refuses anyone else without calling setAssignee
the first-author exception looks for the artifact being authored, not the unit's own: a first HLD or plan is let through when its issue cannot be created
the implicit claim in teamGate and the explicit claim keep their own refusal wording for a failed add and a contested claim
